title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Ampitheater on 1982-10-09

ai_review.summary: Exceptional soundboard capture of a wonderful Dead show, hailed as the best‑sounding copy on Internet Archive.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the audio quality, calling it the best sounding version they’ve heard and describing the listening experience as incredible. Although no specific songs or performance details are mentioned, the enthusiasm suggests a high‑energy, memorable concert that translates well through this superb soundboard recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews focus on outstanding sound quality and overall show enjoyment, indicating both a top‑tier performance and an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as the best‑sounding copy they've heard, noting crystal‑clear, incredible sound with no reported issues.
